newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Terminals to buy into port firm.
newsitem.headline: Asian Terminals to buy into port firm.

text.p: Asian Terminals Inc said on Wednesday it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to take a 60 percent stake in Aries Arrastre Services Inc (AASI).

ATI said this would enable it to participate in the potentially lucrative port of Batangas. AASI has a contract with the government's Philippine Ports Authority (PPA) to provide cargo handling services at the port of the province of Batangas.
The contract runs up to January 16, 2002.
Batangas is located about 90 km south of Manila.
Under the MOU, ATI will infuse an undisclosed amount of capital in AASI to give it a 60 percent stake in the increased capital of AASI.
The agreement between the two firms, however, will require the approval of the PPA.
ATI is the sole container terminal operator for the South Harbour in Manila. It is also the sole multi-cargo operator for the port of Manila.
